QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` not defined (default) | macros for `calloc` / `free` (`platform.h:166-167`)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that in the default build (no MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY), mbedtls_calloc and mbedtls_free are macros for calloc/free, i.e. direct expansion with no indirection.
